_comment: Default service catalogue. Prices are editable starting suggestions in sen (RM1 = 100 sen). After launch, edit prices in Admin > Services; this file only seeds a new database and is the offline fallback. Run `node scripts/generate-seed.mjs` after editing.

services.name: Starter Website
services.tagline: A fast, professional site to get your business found online.
services.description: Perfect for new businesses, freelancers and local services that need a credible web presence quickly. Built mobile-first on a modern stack, with a design customised to your brand.
services.timeline_text: 7–14 working days after we receive your content
deliverables: Up to 5 pages (e.g. Home, About, Services, Gallery, Contact) at the base price
Mobile-first responsive design customised to your logo and colours
Contact form with email notification and WhatsApp click-to-chat button
Basic on-page SEO: page titles, meta descriptions, sitemap and Google Search Console submission
Google Maps embed and social media links
Free SSL and deployment to a free-tier host (Vercel/Netlify) or your existing hosting
30 days of post-launch bug fixes
exclusions: Domain name and paid hosting fees (we can register them for you at cost)
Copywriting beyond light editing of the text you provide
Logo or brand identity design
Online payments, bookings or e-commerce features
Paid stock photos or premium plugin licences
Ongoing content updates after the 30-day support window (see Maintenance plans)
services.price_notes: Base price covers up to 5 pages in English. Extra pages, bilingual (BM/EN) content or copywriting move the price towards the top of the range and are confirmed in writing before work starts.

services.name: Business Website
services.tagline: A custom-designed site that turns visitors into enquiries.
services.description: For established SMEs that need a distinctive design, content they can edit themselves, and proper tracking of where their leads come from.
deliverables: Up to 12 pages with a custom design (mock-up approved before build)
Content management so your team can edit pages, news or blog posts
Lead capture forms with email notifications and spam protection
Google Analytics 4 and Search Console setup
On-page SEO, structured data (schema) and performance optimisation for Core Web Vitals
WhatsApp / live chat integration
Optional bilingual (BM/EN) structure
1-hour handover training and 30 days of post-launch bug fixes
exclusions: Copywriting, photography and video production (available as quoted add-ons)
Paid theme, plugin or third-party software licences
E-commerce and online payment features
Domain, hosting and email hosting fees
Guaranteed search rankings — no honest agency can promise these

services.name: E-commerce Website
services.tagline: Sell online with secure local payments and simple order management.
services.description: An online store on Shopify, WooCommerce or a custom Next.js build — chosen to fit your budget, catalogue size and how you want to manage orders.
deliverables: Store setup with up to 50 products loaded from your spreadsheet (more as a quoted add-on)
Payment gateway integration (cards, FPX and e-wallets supported by your chosen gateway) using your own merchant account
Shipping zones and rates, discount codes and tax settings
Order notification emails and basic inventory tracking
Mobile-optimised product, cart and checkout pages
On-page SEO for product and category pages
1-hour training session plus a recorded video walkthrough
exclusions: Payment gateway fees, merchant account approval and platform subscriptions (e.g. Shopify plan) — billed to you directly by the provider
Product photography and product descriptions
Marketplace integrations (Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop) unless quoted
Custom ERP / accounting integrations unless quoted

services.name: Custom Web Application
services.tagline: Portals, dashboards and internal tools built around your workflow.
services.description: Booking systems, client portals, internal dashboards and SaaS MVPs. Scoped in a paid or free discovery session and delivered in milestones you approve.
services.timeline_text: Typically 6–16 weeks, confirmed in the proposal
deliverables: Discovery session and written requirements specification
UI/UX wireframes for key screens
Full-stack build (e.g. Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL/Supabase) with user accounts and roles
Admin dashboard and third-party API integrations as scoped
Automated tests for critical flows, deployment and documentation
Milestone-based delivery and payments
exclusions: Features not listed in the signed proposal (change requests are quoted separately)
Third-party service, API and hosting fees
Ongoing support after the warranty period (see Maintenance plans)

services.name: AI Chatbot Integration
services.tagline: A 24/7 website assistant that answers FAQs and captures leads.
services.description: An AI chatbot trained on your business information that answers common questions, collects enquiries and hands over to you on WhatsApp when a human is needed.
deliverables: Chatbot set up on one website, trained on your FAQ, services and policies (up to ~20 pages of content at the base price)
Lead capture (name, phone, email) delivered to your email or Google Sheet
Hand-over link to WhatsApp or your contact form
Guardrails so the bot does not invent prices, promises or policies
Two rounds of answer tuning in the first 14 days
exclusions: AI model usage fees from the AI provider (usually low; billed to your own account)
WhatsApp Business Platform (API) integration and Meta conversation fees
CRM integrations and languages beyond English and Bahasa Malaysia unless quoted

services.name: AI Workflow Automation
services.tagline: Stop copy-pasting. Automate the repetitive work between your apps.
services.description: We map one or two of your repetitive processes and automate them — for example enquiries to CRM to follow-up messages, invoice reminders, report generation or document summarisation.
deliverables: Process mapping session and written automation plan
1–2 automated workflows using n8n, Make, Zapier or custom code
AI steps (classification, summarisation, drafting) with human approval where decisions matter
Error alerts and a simple run log
Documentation and a handover call
exclusions: Subscription fees for automation platforms and APIs (billed to your account)
Systems without an API or export option
Automating decisions that legally require human sign-off

services.name: AI Customer Support System
services.tagline: Answer customers instantly across channels — with humans in control.
services.description: A knowledge-based support assistant for your website and messaging channels, with escalation to your team, conversation history and insight into what customers ask most.
deliverables: Knowledge base built from your documents, FAQs and policies
Website support assistant plus one messaging channel via official APIs where available
Escalation rules and human hand-over
Conversation logs and a monthly report of top questions
Staff training session
exclusions: Meta/WhatsApp Business Platform fees and AI model usage fees
Helpdesk or CRM software licences
24/7 human support staffing

services.name: Custom AI Agent Development
services.tagline: AI agents that do real work — with approvals where it matters.
services.description: Purpose-built AI agents that research, draft, triage or operate tools on your behalf, designed with permissions, audit logs and human approval for sensitive actions.
deliverables: Discovery workshop and agent design document
Tool and API integrations with least-privilege access
Human-in-the-loop approval steps and audit logging
Evaluation tests to measure quality before go-live
Deployment, monitoring and handover
exclusions: AI model usage and third-party API fees
Actions the agent should not take without human approval (we design these out)
Work outside the signed proposal

services.name: Basic Website Maintenance
services.tagline: Keep your site secure, backed up and online.
services.description: Essential care for small websites. Cancel anytime — your plan stays active until the end of the paid month.
deliverables: Monthly software, plugin and security updates
Uptime monitoring with alerts
Monthly backup
Up to 30 minutes of small content edits per month (does not roll over)
Email support with a 2-business-day response target
exclusions: New pages, features or redesigns (quoted separately)
Domain and hosting fees unless separately agreed
Fixing issues caused by third-party changes beyond the included time

services.name: Business Maintenance
services.description: For businesses whose website generates leads. Includes regular edits and a monthly health report.
deliverables: Everything in Basic Website Maintenance
Weekly backups
Up to 2 hours of content or design edits per month (does not roll over)
Monthly performance, SEO health and analytics summary
Minor bug fixes
Priority email/WhatsApp support with a 1-business-day response target
exclusions: New features or major redesigns (quoted separately)
Paid advertising management
Third-party licence and hosting fees

services.name: Premium Maintenance & Support
services.tagline: Your on-call web and AI team, every month.
services.description: For businesses that rely on their website, chatbot or automations every day and want ongoing development time.
deliverables: Everything in Business Maintenance
Up to 5 hours of development, edits or automation tweaks per month (does not roll over)
Daily backups where your hosting supports them
AI chatbot / automation content updates for systems we built
Quarterly 30-minute strategy call
Same-business-day response target for critical issues (Mon–Fri, 9am–6pm MYT)
exclusions: Work beyond the included hours (billed at an agreed hourly rate)
Third-party licence, AI usage and hosting fees
24/7 on-call support
